reasons.text: EV Service Technician job postings in Nashik rose from 26 to 48 (last 2 quarters vs the 2 before).
Employers surveyed in Nashik asked for 20 people for EV Service Technician in their latest answers, up from 14 two quarters earlier.
EV battery-pack assembly unit announced (synthetic), a simulated event, is expected to add about 180 EV Service Technician jobs in Nashik in 2026Q4, 2027Q1, 2027Q2, 2027Q3.
